SpaceX’s major announcement from last week has had the big three US carriers on the defensive. items.summary: The executive has held roles at UMG for over two decades.
items.body: Jim Roppo , chairman and CEO of Republic Records, has exited the company and is headed to Warner Records, multiple sources tell Billboard. At Warner Records, he’ll take on the role of vice chairman, reporting to chairman/CEO Aaron Bay-Schuck . A nearly 30-year veteran of Universal Music Group (UMG), the parent company of Republic Records, Roppo has held roles in sales, marketing and commerce at Island Def Jam Music Group (IDJ) and Republic before being promoted to the Republic executive team. He moved from IDJ to Republic in 2012, and in 2018, he was promoted from head of marketing and commerce to executive vp/general manager at Republic, before being upped to co-president of the label in 2021. He then became president/COO of the reorganized REPUBLIC in 2024, before being named chairman/CEO of Republic Records. Warner Records did not respond to Billboard ‘s request for comment. items.title: Samsung Galaxy phones can’t tell if they’re connected to Bluetooth or not
items.summary: The Samsung Galaxy's volume slider is mixing up its connected device icons.
items.body: Credit: Aamir Siddiqui / Android Authority TL;DR Samsung Galaxy phone users are experiencing a strange bug affecting the volume panel. When playing audio through the phone’s speakers, a Bluetooth icon appears at the bottom of the slider. Instead of an earbud icon, a speaker icon reportedly appears when earbuds are connected. You may not always notice it, but the volume slider on your Galaxy phone conveys more information than just the volume level. Whether you’re listening to music through your earbuds or blasting it through your Bluetooth speakers, there will be a little symbol at the bottom of the panel that lets you know what your phone is connected to. However, a new bug is causing issues with this indicator. Samsung Galaxy phone users ( 1 , 2 , 3 ) are experiencing a strange glitch affecting the volume panel. When playing audio through the handset’s speakers, a Bluetooth icon appears at the bottom of the slider. That should not be happening, as it suggests the phone is connected to a Bluetooth device even though it is disconnected. Users also report seeing a speaker icon instead of an earbud icon when their earbuds are connected.

items.title: Survey reveals Kindle readers aren’t buying Amazon’s pricey page-turning solution
items.summary: Amazon's new Kindle Page-Turn Cover promises extra convenience, but our readers have strong opinions about the price tag.
items.body: Credit: Amazon Physical page-turn buttons might seem like a pretty basic feature for an e-reader , but Amazon has spent years leaving them off its Kindle lineup. The company has given bookworms a way to bring them back with its latest devices, although it’s charging a hefty premium for the privilege. We recently asked readers whether they’d be willing to pay $80 for this convenience, and the results suggest Amazon might have misread the room. As my colleague Dhruv Bhutani explained in his recent look at the 2026 Kindle refresh , Amazon’s new Page-Turn Cover adds physical buttons to the e-reader through a magnetic connection. The catch is that it costs $80 and it only works with the Signature Editions of the Kindle Paperwhite and Colorsoft, which already cost $250 and $320, respectively. That makes $330 the minimum entry price if you want physical buttons on a new Kindle. We wanted to know whether you thought this was fair enough, or if perhaps Amazon should have just included this functionality as part of the deal.

The researchers discovered the Treble Clef is likely caused by an outburst from a supermassive black hole, followed by a collision of two galaxy clusters. A paper describing the findings, led by Andrea Botteon of the National Institute for Astrophysics, or INAF, in Italy, published Wednesday in the Astronomy & Astrophysics journal . An explanation for the Treble Clef has been particularly difficult to find because the formation lies almost directly behind the plane of the Milky Way, meaning that stars, gas, and dust from our home galaxy largely block the view from Earth. items.summary: Google is bringing more scam protections to Android and Google Messages.
items.body: Credit: C. Scott Brown / Android Authority TL;DR Google has announced a raft of security-related additions coming to Android phones. The company will now offer an Enhanced Protection mode in Google Messages along with call-forwarding warnings. Google is also bringing Scam Detection for chat notifications to a ton of other Android phones globally. There’s no shortage of security-focused features in Android, including Advanced Protection Mode , Scam Detection for calls and texts, and theft detection . However, Google is marking Cybersecurity Awareness Month with a raft of additions to Android. For starters, Google will offer an Enhanced Protection mode in Google Messages later this month. Opt in to this mode and you’ll activate Scam Detection with “secure” cloud analysis, warnings for links from unfamiliar numbers, and malicious link protection powered by Gemini Nano.

items.title: Survey confirms the ‘hidden’ part of this Pixel hidden gem
items.summary: We knew Pixel VIPs was underrated, and you proved just how much.
items.body: TL;DR Nearly 79% of respondents to our recent poll said they had never heard of Pixel VIPs, despite the feature being over a year old. Only 7% said they use Pixel VIPs regularly, while 14% expressed interest in trying it out. Google recently upgraded Pixel VIPs with one-tap calling and messaging, notification badges, and a redesigned interface. Google first introduced a seamless way to give some of your favorite contacts elevated importance and permissions with the June 2025 Pixel Feature Drop . Called Pixel VIPs , the feature essentially let you give some contacts a spot on your home screen through a dedicated widget. Fast forward to last month, and Google rolled out improvements with Pixel VIPs 2.0. However, despite the upgrade, a large portion of our users don’t even know this exists at all. We recently ran a poll asking our users whether they use Pixel VIPs, and a whopping majority of 1,545 respondents said they’ve never heard of the feature.

items.summary: عانى من مشاكل بدنية
items.body: عانى من مشاكل بدنية أعلن نجم منتخب المغرب، اليوم الأربعاء، اعتزال كرة القدم، عن عمر 32 عاما، بعد مسيرة مميزة. وقرر آدم ماسينا، الاعتزال رسميا رغم أنه في الثانية والثلاثين من عمره فقط. ويأتي هذا الإعلان بعد أشهر قليلة من نهائي كأس الأمم الأفريقية، الذي خاضه مع أسود الأطلس، أمام السنغال، والذي سيظل بالتالي المباراة الأخيرة في مسيرته الكروية.  وبعد أن لعب سابقًا لأندية بولونيا وواتفورد وأودينيزي وتورينو، ظل المدافع المغربي بلا نادٍ منذ مغادرته بولونيا في الدوري الإيطالي في يناير الماضي. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة لكن آدم ماسينا لا ينوي الابتعاد عن عالم كرة القدم في الوقت الحالي، فبحسب صحيفة " كورييري دي بولونيا "، سيخوض المدافع السابق، الذي برز كقلب دفاع للمنتخب المغربي خلال بطولة كأس الأمم الأفريقية الأخيرة، مغامرة جديدة ضمن الجهاز الفني لنادي بروجريسو الإيطالي، أحد أندية الدرجة الرابعة، وسيتولى منصب مساعد المدرب فرانشيسكو سالمي.  ويأتي هذا التغيير المهني مدفوعًا بشكل خاص بالمشاكل البدنية التي عانى منها مؤخرًا، والتي دفعته إلى إنهاء مسيرته الكروية.  ولذلك، يستعد ماسينا، لتجربة كرة القدم من منظور مختلف تمامًا، بعد الانتقال إلى مجال التدريب مباشرة.

items.title: Samsung’s Good Lock team confirms widget text and volume slider bugs
items.summary: If you're also experiencing these problems, you can rest easy knowing Samsung is working on a fix.
items.body: Credit: Ryan Haines / Android Authority TL;DR Good Lock users are reporting a problem with text size when reducing the size of widgets and icons. Samsung states that it is searching for ways to solve the problem. The team has also confirmed a bug where different volume levels are displayed on the Quick Settings panel and the volume panel. One of the nice things about Galaxy phones is how customizable they can be. With the Good Lock app, you can modify almost your entire experience, from adding custom styles and animations to notifications to adjusting the layout and spacing of tiles in Quick Settings. However, as with any software, a bug can ruin the experience. Unfortunately, there are two bugs that are currently annoying Good Lock users. The first bug is connected to the Good Lock module known as Home Up. If you’re not familiar with Home Up, it allows you to reposition apps anywhere on the screen, resize widgets, and more. The problem in question deals with resizing widgets. As one user explains , when they reduce the size of icons and widgets, the text becomes proportional in size. The text can get so small that it becomes illegible.

items.title: Galaxy S27 and S27 Plus will reportedly miss out on a key camera upgrade
items.summary: They could be sticking with a Galaxy S23-era selfie cam.
items.body: TL;DR The Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra are rumored to come with an upgraded front-facing camera. A new rumor says that the S27 and S27 Plus won’t receive the same upgrade. That would make the S27 the fourth consecutive Galaxy S generation to leverage the same 12-megapixel sensor. Galaxy S27 season is creeping up: Samsung’s next non-folding flagships should be here in just a few months. We’ve already seen leaks about the phones’ hardware design , cameras , and other specs . Today, a new camera rumor has popped up, and it’s not great news. Galaxy Club reports that, in contrast with the Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra, the two lesser models will stick with the same front-facing camera as this year’s Galaxy S26 series. That’s a 12-megapixel shooter that’s been unchanged for several generations.

items.body: NASA/John Kraus Sunlight illuminates the exhaust plumes of a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket carrying the company’s Dragon spacecraft on Oct. 13, 2026. This visual phenomenon is known as a “jellyfish”; it happens near sunrise or sunset when the exhaust plume from the rocket becomes brightly illuminated, creating a glowing shape resembling a jellyfish. The mission lifted off at 6:33 a.m. EDT from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, carrying scientific investigations, supplies, and equipment to the International Space Station on SpaceX’s 35th commercial resupply services mission for NASA. The rocket’s exhaust plumes were visible across the eastern United States. Watch the uncrewed Dragon spacecraft rendezvous with and dock to the International Space Station on Oct. 15. items.title: Your Android phone can now shut down or restart your PC
items.summary: Not around your PC to restart or shut it down? The Link to Windows app now lets you do it remotely.
items.body: TL;DR The Link to Windows app is getting new power control options, letting users remotely shut down, restart, or put their computer to sleep. These key functions were first revealed in a report last month and now appear to be rolling out through the latest Link to Windows beta. In addition to letting you control key power options, the new menu in the Link to Windows app also lets you finish updates before you restart or shut down the PC. Microsoft’s Link to Windows is a useful utility app that lets you remotely access certain phone functions on your Windows computer. It currently lets you access phone calls, messages, photos, and transfer files between your desktop and a linked Android phone. We recently learned that Microsoft is adding the ability to remotely shut down , restart, or put your computer to sleep . These functions are now officially rolling out in the Link to Windows app. While Link to Windows currently lets you lock your computer, the version 1.26101.103.0 beta adds additional controls for common actions.

items.body: 5 min read Preparations for Next Moonwalk Simulations Underway (and Underwater) Yi Lin, SPEARS testing and research lead at NASA Langley, holds one of the small coin-cell batteries that had just undergone thermal vacuum testing. NASA/Ryan Hill If you’ve ever had your car start sluggishly, or not at all, on a particularly frigid winter morning, you know standard batteries do not like extreme cold. That’s why NASA researchers are working to develop a battery that could function in the brutal cold of the Moon’s South Pole, where nighttime temperatures plunge to minus 328 degrees Fahrenheit (minus 200 Celsius).  For future lunar operations, a battery will need to work immediately when warmed up and be able to power everything from an astronaut’s emergency kit to a rover capable of exploring the Moon’s darkest craters — all without posing a fire hazard.  A team of NASA researchers is working to make all that happen. The project is called Solid Power for Extreme Environment Adaptability and Resilience in Space (SPEARS), and it could provide NASA with an important tool to help power humanity’s sustained presence on the Moon through the Artemis campaign.  …

items.summary: قمة نارية
items.body: قمة نارية  توج الأهلي المصري بلقب بطولة أفريقيا للأندية لكرة اليد، المقامة في أنجولا، بعد فوز مثير على غريمه ومواطنه الزمالك، بنتيجة 26/25، في المباراة النهائية التي أقيمت اليوم الأربعاء. وبذلك يحصد الأهلي اللقب القاري للمرة الرابعة على التوالي، والتاسعة في تاريخه، فيما نال الزمالك الميدالية الفضية في البطولة التي حقق لقبها من قبل 12 مرة (رقم قياسي). ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة وشهدت المباراة إثارة بالغة حتى الثواني الأخيرة التي نجح فيها الأهلي في تسجيل هدف الفوز، ليحصد اللقب الثمين. وانتهى الشوط الأول من المباراة بتقدم الزمالك 10/9 بعد أداء قوي من الفريقين. وفي الشوط الثاني نجح الأهلي في إدراك التعادل في الثواني الأخيرة 22/22 لتتجه المباراة لشوطين إضافيين. وتواصلت الإثارة في الشوط الإضافي الأول الذي انتهى بالتعادل 24/24 وسط حماس قوي من القطبين المصريين. وفي الشوط الثاني الإضافي وصلت الإثارة ذروتها حيث تعادل الفريقان 25/25 في الدقيقة الأخيرة وكانت الكرة مع لاعبي الزمالك، الذين أهدروا فرصة التسجيل ليشن الأهلي هجمة سريعة سجل منها هدف الفوز القاتل قبل انتهاء المباراة بثوان قليلة.

items.title: Yikes: Google let a fake Chrome app on the Play Store, and it got over 100,000 downloads
items.summary: Sideloading is risky, but apparently so is the Play Store.
items.body: TL;DR A fake Google Chrome app with over 100,000 downloads was available on the Play Store. The app, from a developer named “Hizbartech,” even paid its way to the top of the search results for “Chrome.” Google has since removed the app, but it raises questions about the Play Store’s review and ad practices. Google talks a big game about trying to keep the Android ecosystem safe and secure. The company recently started cracking down on sideloading apps because malicious actors can easily create fake apps and trick users into installing them. Instead, Google wants users to install apps directly from the Play Store. The idea is that installing apps from the Play Store pretty much guarantees you won’t install a fake or malicious app. However, Google doesn’t seem to be doing a stellar job of keeping the Play Store safe, either.

items.title: Android Fast Pair could soon support even more accessories, and that’s good news for your health
items.summary: Google is seemingly working to expand Fast Pair support to health devices, including smart BP monitors.
items.body: Credit: Mishaal Rahman / Android Authority TL;DR Fast Pair on Android could soon support health-related devices. Code already confirms support for Bluetooth BP monitors, but it could also include glucometers, pulse oximeters, smart weighing scales, and other similar devices. Along with this, support devices could also let you choose whether or not to sync data with Health Connect, directly at the time of setup. Google’s Fast Pair is one of Android’s most convenient features, which lets you connect Bluetooth accessories (and verify their authenticity) without the usual hassle. It already works with a variety of accessories for your Android device, including wireless earbuds or headphones, smart glasses, keyboards, mice, styluses, etc. Last year, Google also expanded Fast Pair support to hearing aids , making them much easier to connect to your device. Android foldables have used graphite sheets as part of the display stack or on the chassis on either side of the spine, but have not typically used the spine itself for cooling. Foldables have spent years balancing thinner profiles with flagship-grade SoCs and the resulting thermal dilemma. This essential resource aims to equip parliamentarians with the knowledge and tools necessary to enhance global health security efforts.
